terminology.source_owner: the organization that owns/produces the upstream data (who owns the data); never erased by a transport wrapper
terminology.source_domain: addressable domain/endpoint family under a source_owner (e.g. push2 vs datacenter vs push2ex under eastmoney)
terminology.transport_client: the client/library that performs the network transport (e.g. urllib/requests/akshare/mootdx/TushareClient); a transport client may carry multiple upstreams and must NOT erase source_owner identity
terminology.entrypoint: the exact module symbol that fetches a given dataset

stores.purpose: BK-11 daily-facts strict JSON envelope persistence
stores.append_style: keyed by (trade_date, session); legacy save_daily_facts is plain INSERT OR REPLACE (same-key overwrite); v0.2 save_daily_facts_monotonic allows partial->normal UPDATE (upgraded) and blocks normal->partial / conflicting normal->normal / v0.1-same-key; unavailable/invalid/non-final never written
stores.timestamp_semantics: stored_at UTC; envelope fetched_at/snapshot_at UTC ISO; trade_date
stores.integrity: WAL, read-only conns, FactStoreCorruptedError, strict JSON validation (rejects NaN)
stores.reuse_note: reusable storage/validation pattern (strict envelope + monotonic quality + schema_meta); NOT a completed DS-A1 CanonicalFact layer and NOT an immutable raw-observation store - it stores validated envelopes keyed by trade_date/session with permitted partial->normal UPDATE
stores.boundary: EXTEND (reusable pattern; raw immutable observation and revision/vintage semantics are NEW_FOR_FACT_LAKE)
